# Migration & Data Safety Checklist: Documents and Letters (017)

**Purpose**: Validate that the *requirements* governing 017's schema changes are precise, complete
and testable enough to execute against a populated database without losing data or silently breaking
shipped behaviour.
**Created**: 2026-09-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [research.md](../research.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) · [tasks.md](../tasks.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature
context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an
item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements
quality. It does **not** mean implementation work is complete.

**Depth**: formal gate — this precedes `ALTER TABLE … SET SCHEMA` on a populated table.
**Audience**: reviewer, before `/speckit-implement` reaches Phase 5.

> **Why this checklist exists.** Phases 1–4 create new tables and can be reverted by dropping them.
> Phase 5 rewrites tables that Recruitment's shipped offer and appointment letters depend on. Every
> item below asks whether the *specification* is adequate — not whether code works.

---

## Reversibility & Failure Paths

- [ ] CHK001 - Are rollback requirements defined for the `GeneratedLetter` → `IssuedLetter` schema move? [Gap, research §2, tasks T031]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does any artifact specify the expected system state if the Phase 5 migration sequence half-applies — for example the schema move succeeding but the CHECK constraint failing? [Gap, tasks T031–T033]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the three enum-conversion steps specified as a single atomic migration or as separately deployable ones, and is the intermediate state (nullable `letterKindId`, partially backfilled) defined as acceptable or forbidden? [Ambiguity, research §1, tasks T028–T030]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for whether the application must be offline during Phase 5, or whether concurrent writes to `GeneratedLetter` are tolerated mid-migration? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is there a stated requirement that each migration be independently re-runnable, or is exactly-once application assumed? [Assumption, Gap]

## Backfill Correctness

- [ ] CHK006 - Is the behaviour specified for a `GeneratedLetter` row whose `letterType` value matches no seeded `LetterKind.key`? [Gap, research §1, tasks T029]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the ordering requirement between seeding kinds (T027) and backfilling references (T029) stated as a dependency rather than implied by task numbering? [Clarity, tasks T027, T029]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the requirement that seeded keys be **byte-identical** to the five existing enum values written anywhere a reviewer can check, rather than inferred from "with identical keys"? [Clarity, tasks T027]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is a post-backfill verification requirement defined — e.g. that zero rows retain a NULL `letterKindId` before `SET NOT NULL` is attempted? [Gap, Measurability]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are requirements defined for what happens to `LetterTemplate` rows referencing an enum value with no corresponding kind, distinctly from `GeneratedLetter` rows? [Coverage, Gap]

## Constraint Addition Against Existing Rows

- [ ] CHK011 - Is it stated whether existing `GeneratedLetter` rows are **guaranteed** to satisfy the exactly-one-addressing-form CHECK at the moment it is added? [Gap, data-model.md, tasks T033]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are requirements defined for rows where **both** `employeeId` and `candidateId` are NULL — is that state currently possible, and does the CHECK reject it? [Edge Case, Gap, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the behaviour specified if adding the CHECK constraint fails because pre-existing data violates it — abort the migration, or quarantine the offending rows? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the `@@unique([companyId, key])` requirement on `LetterKind` unambiguous given `companyId` is **nullable**? Postgres treats NULLs as distinct in unique indexes, so this constraint as written would permit two product-shipped kinds sharing a key. [Conflict, data-model.md, research §1]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the partial unique index on `CompanyDocument` specified precisely enough to be unambiguous about which row is "current" — including immediately after an upload and before the previous row's `supersedesId` is set? [Clarity, data-model.md, tasks T008]

## Retention & Deletion

- [ ] CHK016 - Does FR-006 ("retain superseded documents rather than replacing them") specify whether the underlying **storage blob** is retained, or only the database row? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is any retention bound specified for superseded documents — indefinite, or deleted after a stated period? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK018 - Given Aadhaar is regulated personal data under FR-024, are retention and deletion requirements defined for superseded **Aadhaar** documents specifically, or does the general retain-forever rule apply to it too? [Conflict, Spec §FR-006 vs §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are requirements defined for what happens to stored blobs when a company is deleted, given `onDelete: Cascade` removes the rows that point at them? [Gap, Coverage, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the deletion semantics of `DELETE /company-documents/:id` specified unambiguously as supersession rather than removal, in the contract as well as the spec? [Consistency, contracts Part 2, Spec §FR-006]

## Pre-Existing Data & Row-Level Security

- [ ] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for rows that exist **before** an RLS policy is applied — specifically whether any pre-existing row could become invisible because its `companyId` does not satisfy the new policy? [Gap, Coverage, tasks T007, T034]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is the `companyId IS NULL` admission for `LetterKind`'s policy stated as a requirement, or only as an implementation note? A policy without it makes every product-shipped kind invisible to every tenant. [Clarity, tasks T034, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is the vacuousness check — disabling the policy and confirming rows **do** appear — stated as a requirement the feature must satisfy, or only as a task step that could be dropped? [Traceability, tasks T068, quickstart Pass 9]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the requirement that the RLS probe role be `NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS` traceable to a stated rationale, so a future reader does not "simplify" it back to a superuser? [Clarity, tasks T067]

## Shipped Behaviour Preservation

- [ ] CHK025 - Is "Recruitment's existing offer and appointment letter behaviour continues unchanged" expressed as an objectively **testable** criterion, or only as a prose assumption? [Measurability, Spec Assumptions, research §2]
- [ ] CHK026 - Does any requirement enumerate *which* existing Recruitment behaviours must be preserved — issue, render, list, supersede — so the regression gate (T035) has a defined pass condition? [Gap, Completeness, tasks T035]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are requirements defined for existing queries and code paths that reference `recruitment.GeneratedLetter` by name, and how they are identified before the table moves? [Gap, Coverage, research §2]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is the renaming of the model (`GeneratedLetter` → `IssuedLetter`) specified as occurring in the same migration as the schema move, or separately? [Ambiguity, tasks T031]

## Seeding & Idempotency

- [ ] CHK029 - Is the `DocumentType.isRestricted` seed specified precisely enough to be idempotent if the migration is re-applied? [Gap, tasks T004]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are requirements defined for how `isRestricted` and the required-kind sets apply to companies created **after** the migration, versus those existing at migration time? [Coverage, Gap, tasks T002, T004]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is it specified whether the `LetterKind` seed runs in a migration or in `prisma/seed.ts`? research.md explicitly defers this to tasks, and tasks.md does not resolve it. [Gap, research §"Open items", tasks T027]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are requirements defined for what happens when a company has already customised a seeded kind and the seed runs again? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Traceability & Acceptance

- [ ] CHK033 - Does any success criterion in spec.md cover migration correctness, or do SC-001…SC-00n address only post-migration functionality? [Gap, Completeness, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are the six research decisions each traceable to at least one requirement in spec.md, so a decision cannot be silently reversed during implementation? [Traceability, research §1–§6]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is the claim that `LetterKind.approvalActionType` must equal 016's exported constants stated as a requirement, or only as a test task? A test asserts it; nothing requires it. [Traceability, tasks T036, Spec §FR-015a]

---

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers. Every item above is
  deliberately left unchecked — this artifact is the reviewer's, and the agent that wrote the
  specifications is not the right party to certify them.
- Items CHK014, CHK018 and CHK031 are the ones most likely to be genuine defects rather than
  documentation gaps, and are worth reading first.
- Where an item asks "is X specified?", answering it by *adding* the specification is a valid
  resolution — the checklist is a prompt to improve the requirements, not a test to argue with.
